title: Opsolete template 1.0
description: A catalog template: a Terraform module at a pinned ref and the form inputs that set its variables. Opsolete's loader is the reference: it also checks what a schema can't (show_if refers to an earlier input, select defaults and show_if values are options, at most one key, patterns compile).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; names the template in workspaces and URLs.

adopt.description: Resources of the module that can adopt existing cloud resources when the template is added: the user pastes their IDs, the run imports them instead of creating them.

source.description: A git:: URL or a registry module address.

ref.description: The approved Git ref or registry version.

label.description: The question end users see; empty: the name.

help.description: Shown under the field, and as the error when the pattern doesn't match.

pattern.description: A Go regular expression the whole value must match (string inputs).

default.description: Typed by the input's type: string and select a string, number a number, bool a boolean.

sensitive.description: Stored sealed, typed in a password field, never shown (string and number inputs, no default).

key.description: At most one input: its value names the template's module in a workspace (not bool or sensitive).

per_environment.description: A project may set the value for all its workspaces, overriding theirs at every run (not sensitive or key).

option.description: A select choice: a string is both value and label.

to.description: The resource's address in the module, e.g. azurerm_linux_virtual_machine.this or azurerm_windows_virtual_machine.self[0]; unique.

label.description: The field end users see; empty: the address.

help.description: Shown under the field, and as the error when the pattern doesn't match.

pattern.description: A Go regular expression the whole ID must match, e.g. (?i)/subscriptions/[^/]+/resourceGroups/[^/]+.

list.description: Scanning: the provider's list resource type that finds this entry's resources (terraform query), e.g. azurerm_windows_virtual_machine. With list and without id_from, each resource found is a candidate to adopt.

require.description: Scanning: only resources whose attribute at this path is set count, e.g. provision_vm_agent (azurerm's Linux VM list also returns Windows VMs). Needs list.

id_from.description: Scanning: this resource's ID is the candidate's attribute at this path, e.g. network_interface_ids[0].

inputs.description: Scanning: input name to the attribute path whose value fills it, e.g. {"size": "size", "os_disk_type": "os_disk[0].storage_account_type"}.

placeholder.description: Sensitive inputs filled with a random value when adopting (values the cloud never returns, which the module must ignore_changes).

show_if.description: Show the input only while an earlier select or bool input has one of these values (typed like that input: strings for a select, booleans for a bool).
